Melbourne CBD outdoor pedestrian sensor locations

sensors.Rd

Name, location and data coverage for each outdoor pedestrian sensor in foot_traffic. One row is one sensor.

Usage

sensors

Format

A tibble with 195128 rows and 6 columns:

location_id

Sensor identifier. Joins to foot_traffic.

location_name

Description of where the sensor is, for example "Melbourne Central".

latitude

Latitude in decimal degrees.

longitude

Longitude in decimal degrees.

installation_date

Date the sensor was installed.

days_observed

Number of days between 1 October 2025 and 30 September 2026 on which the sensor reported counts.

Source

City of Melbourne Open Data, Pedestrian Counting System - Sensor Locations, https://data.melbourne.vic.gov.au/explore/dataset/pedestrian-counting-system-sensor-locations/. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.

Details

Sensors are placed by the City of Melbourne based on retail and event activity and regular pedestrian use, so busy areas are better covered than quieter streets. A location without a sensor cannot be assessed.
